purpose: Free, entirely local browser inspection of text descriptions in a user-provided crypto exchange CSV. Extracts review-only direction and quantity candidates, refuses ambiguous rows and never uploads the file. Not tax advice or importer-ready transactions.

interaction.const: Use the browser UI with a chosen local source CSV

outputs: Review-only candidate rows and explicit NOT_PARSED exceptions inside the browser. No remote structured API, upload, transaction finality or Koinly tax file is promised.

examples.description: Open the free site and load its fictional CSV example, then analyze locally.

request.interaction: Use the browser UI with a chosen local source CSV
